items.text: The Indiana School Nutrition Association helps promote quality nutrition in schools across Indiana. Earlier this week, some of their members stopped by to discuss the ongoing challenges facing parents and educators in ensuring that students have access to healthy meals at school. https://t.co/5v6Pz78NCE

No Hoosier struggling with a substance use disorder should have to wait a year before receiving lifesaving treatment. I'm proud to introduce the bipartisan Timely Treatment for Opioid Use Disorder Act to help increase access to treatment for all Americans. https://t.co/z5HYGy1JAQ

#ICYMI: This past Friday I was in Spurgeon at the groundbreaking of their new wastewater treatment plant. This project will assist over 200 people with services and help improve the health and safety of this community and the surrounding areas. https://t.co/Havamk9eQC

Efforts to support women with maternal mental health issues lack coordinated action from the federal government and as a result, 50% of new moms never receive treatment. In @HouseCommerce, we discussed my TRIUMPH for New Moms Act to support maternal health in America. https://t.co/pDz3TnyO0K

Yesterday, the Homeless Day Center opened in Terre Haute to help homeless and at-risk populations in the Wabash Valley. This facility will promote access to housing and employment services and provide a place to sleep, shower, and use computers. https://t.co/GE7nlCK78B

Last week, @DeptVetAffairs launched an improved Access to Care website that offers a simplified, user-friendly experience to help Veterans make informed decisions as they plan their healthcare appointments. Check out their new website here ⬇️ https://t.co/qJsFNWDqrW

🚨 My Improving Seniors’ Timely Access to Care Act is one step closer to being signed into law.
 
TOMORROW: @WaysandMeansGOP will hold a markup of this critical bill to reform prior authorization in Medicare so patients don’t experience delayed care. 
https://t.co/EiXzyp2Efk

We can and should work on a bipartisan basis to lower drug costs. It’s possible to do so without sacrificing the cures and treatments that will provide for a healthier future—but not if Democrats’ reconciliation bill passes in its current form. https://t.co/FbkDbwOHWJ

I stopped by the YMCA of Southwest Indiana this week and discussed some of the ways this community center has made an impact for Hoosiers, especially through their wellness programs. I look forward to seeing their new facility in Gibson County. https://t.co/nOfQsw1M3F

My career as a cardiothoracic surgeon helps inform the work I do here in Congress, including ensuring doctors and patients have the support they need from the federal government. This week, I met with @STS_CTsurgery to discuss ways I am fighting for better healthcare in the U.S. https://t.co/ZYOxqNFppu
#ICYMI: I penned an op-ed for @modrnhealthcr expressing the need to pass my bipartisan SAVE Act to help protect our nation’s healthcare workers. https://t.co/K0EwQrPjW2

I’m proud that my bipartisan Physician Wellness Program Act, which will remove barriers that may prevent physicians from accessing important mental health and wellness programs, is one step closer to being signed into law. https://t.co/4AN2j2VlN2

My bipartisan Physician Wellness Program Act would expand access to critical mental health programs for many providers. #ICYMI: This bill has passed out of committee and now heads toward the House floor. https://t.co/C0azB7Jhws

More than 28 million seniors are enrolled in Medicare Advantage, including 560,731 in Indiana. I am honored to be named a 2022 Medicare Advantage Champion by @BMAlliance for my work on behalf of Hoosier seniors. https://t.co/obNM0t3ymw
Through December 7, eligible seniors have the opportunity to join, drop, or switch their Medicare coverage plans. Learn more about the resources available to you here ⬇️ https://t.co/1ncbUgaEEk

Did you know that from 2001-2021, Medicare physician reimbursement declined by 20%, while the cost of operating a medical practice went up by 39%? Read about how my Supporting Medicare Providers Act would help providers and patients in the below op-ed ⬇️ https://t.co/NiaFY3pQmb

Three deadly shootings have taken place in hospitals since June, the latest being Saturday’s attack at Methodist Dallas Medical Center. Hospitals are supposed to be places of healing, not violence – my SAVE Act would protect workers in these institutions. https://t.co/KcKfdjvJmA

I urge @GOPLeader, @SpeakerPelosi, and my colleagues in the House to urgently pass this critical legislation that will deter violence in our nation’s hospitals and keep these vital institutions safe for our patients, providers, and all healthcare workers. https://t.co/oPmpEfI7qn

House Republicans’ #CommitmentToAmerica includes policies that will help Americans achieve longer, healthier lives. Together, let’s build a freer future, and put healthcare back in the hands of patients and their doctors. https://t.co/uVmLdr7Myj

As the Healthy Future Task Force Subcommittee on Doctor/Patient Relationships, @RepGregMurphy, @RepBethVanDuyne, and I have a plan to put patients back in the driver’s seat of their medical decisions and bolster the Republican commitment to a freer future. https://t.co/j5tF8zGtRb https://t.co/waKnQp0P5N

My bipartisan SAVE Act will help protect doctors and patients from increased incidents of violence in our nation’s hospitals. @statnews covers how this bill will help our healthcare community. https://t.co/R43Bh5TgGN

Doctors deserve to be paid fairly for the cost of the care they provide. That is why @RepBera and I penned an op-ed for @TheHill outlining our plan to protect physicians from Medicare pay cuts that would negatively impact patient care.

@TheISMA President, is right: “The Medicare Physician Fee Schedule - the system that determines the rates at which physicians working with Medicare are reimbursed - is beyond broken and it is time for Congress to fix it.” Learn more about my work on this⬇️ https://t.co/hhymMJSDVW

Great op-ed from the Chief Medical Officer of @TheUSONetwork on one of the reasons Congress needs to pass my bipartisan Supporting Medicare Providers Act of 2022 (H.R. 8800) and protect patients from the effects of looming Medicare cuts. https://t.co/Cdh7851Sps

Now is the time for Congress to #StopTheFullCut by passing my bipartisan Supporting Medicare Providers Act to prevent Medicare reimbursement cuts from taking effect at the start of the new year. https://t.co/g8tWF5VuHY
